records.label: spacr.model_zoo.download_bundled_models#2
records.source: The downloader stages the whole pack in a temporary sibling directory and atomically renames the completed directory into place after every download succeeds. It does not verify published checksums and trusts an existing non-empty cache without checking its completeness or origin. Prefer a catalogue entry with a hash and :func:`install` when checksum verification is required.
